architecture_summary.localization_policy: Two-tier lexical-first (ripgrep) with semantic similarity fallback
architecture_summary.graph_reasoning_policy: Confidence-gated adaptive structural expansion (callers, callees, hierarchy)
architecture_summary.patch_minimality_policy: Surgical diff bounds, indentation preservation, 2D relative coordinate guard
architecture_summary.verification_policy: Pre-patch and post-patch targeted pytest execution
architecture_summary.repair_policy: Bounded closed-loop test-driven repair (max 3 cycles) with traceback failure classification
architecture_summary.stopping_policy: Immediate termination upon test pass and clean diff verification
